task: Decide whether incoming Team T and Team M benchmark figures are publishable as integrated SDK performance evidence.
observation: Release artifact metadata showed Team T dependency providers at debug opt-level 0 while only the harness was release optimized; source workload counts differed from the Rust baseline. Release disassembly also showed Team M Math/Time constant folding and unobserved Random return values.
impact: All targets are executable, but Team I excluded their comparison figures from the AMBER checkpoint instead of treating successful benchmark commands as valid measurements.

resolution.summary: Owning Teams must correct provider optimization, workload equality, constant inputs, and result observability before comparisons are validated.

tool_used: Margo release benchmarks, artifact metadata, and generated-code inspection
